paraphrase: The Tathāgata is not regarded as form, feeling …, nor as in them or apart from them, nor as without them; since he is not apprehended in truth and reality even in this life, is it fitting to declare him in terms of the four alternatives after death? 'Formerly and now I make known just suffering and the cessation of suffering.'
